sql:
SELECT sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS SalesQuantity, sum(f.ReturnQuantity) AS ReturnQuantity, sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost) AS GrossMarginAmount, (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS GrossMarginPct, sum(f.ReturnQuantity) / nullif(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) AS ReturnRate, countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber) AS OrderCount, sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS AvgOrderValue, countDistinct(f.CustomerKey) AS UniqueCustomers
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE c.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras and camcorders'
